items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair incl. thermal-imaging leak detection
items.rationale: Frost fracture of an internal fitting is covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9, and leak location under 2.4.6 (well within the EUR 2,500 cap); the lump sum prices covered work (7.1.12). Fair market price for fitting renewal, labour, one attendance and thermal imaging.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint)
items.rationale: The plaster failed from outdoor frost acting from without; optional peril 2.1(d) is not shown as agreed, so 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude the work and 7.1.13 drops the whole combined line. No sign the escaped water reached the facade (2.4.3).
